layoutNotes.en: More nodes require new layers, branch spacing and routes between groups.
layoutNotes.zh: 节点增加后，分支、汇合与跨组连线需要重新分层和避障。

layoutNotes.en: More participants and messages change lifeline spacing, frame height and message wrapping.
layoutNotes.zh: 参与者与消息增加后，生命线间距、片段高度和消息换行随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More classes and relationships require additional layers, member sections and connection ports.
layoutNotes.zh: 类和关系增加后，卡片分层、成员分区与关系端口更加明显。

layoutNotes.en: More states and transitions require room for nested regions and transition labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多状态会增加转移通道，复合状态需要独立布局。

layoutNotes.en: More entities require larger attribute cards and clearer relationship routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 实体数量和字段增加后，实体卡片的尺寸与关系分层随之扩展。

layoutNotes.en: More slices require space for labels and a balanced legend.
layoutNotes.zh: 分类增加后，扇区变细，图例和标签更密集。

layoutNotes.en: More tasks require additional rows, dependency routes and date labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多任务和阶段会扩展时间跨度与任务行，窄画布需要更紧凑的时间轴。

layoutNotes.en: More branches and commits require distinct lanes and spaced commit labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 提交和分支增加后，会出现更多分支轨道、合并线与提交标签。

layoutNotes.en: More branches require balanced subtree spacing around the root.
layoutNotes.zh: 分支和层级增加后，左右子树展开，父节点位置随子树高度调整。

layoutNotes.en: More periods and events require additional sections and readable event labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 阶段和事件增加后，横向时间线变长，窄画布会改为纵向排列。

layoutNotes.en: More steps and actors require additional lanes and wrapped task labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多阶段、步骤和参与者会扩展旅程，窄画布会重排步骤卡片。

layoutNotes.en: More data requires readable axes, series spacing and a balanced legend.
layoutNotes.zh: 数据点和系列增加后，柱宽、折线密度、刻度与图例排列随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More requirements require additional layers and readable relationship labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 需求、实现和验证对象增加后，关系图会出现多层追踪路径。

layoutNotes.en: More elements require space for boundaries, cards and relationships.
layoutNotes.zh: 人物、系统边界和服务增加后，跨边界关系和卡片布局更复杂。

layoutNotes.en: More flows require additional layers and proportional flow spacing.
layoutNotes.zh: 来源、流向与权重增加后，节点分层、条带宽度和流量分配随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More blocks require additional rows, columns and connection routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 块数量增加后会换行，跨列块与多行连接形成更丰富的网格。

layoutNotes.en: More fields require additional bit rows and clearly bounded field labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 字段和位宽增加后，字段跨越更多行，窄字段的标签显示也会变化。

layoutNotes.en: More cards require taller columns and readable card labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 列与卡片增加后，列宽、卡片换行和看板高度需要适应容器。

layoutNotes.en: More groups and services require additional layers and explicit connection ports.
layoutNotes.zh: 服务与分组增加后，跨组连接、分支端口与图形中心对齐更加明显。

layoutNotes.en: More axes and series require readable axis labels and a balanced legend.
layoutNotes.zh: 维度与数据系列增加后，网格角度、曲线密度和图例布局随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More values require proportional nested rectangles and readable labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多层级与不均匀权重会改变矩形切分，小面积区域会减少标签。

layoutNotes.en: More agents and branches require additional layers and group routing.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多智能体和任务分支会增加并行路径、汇合点与层级跨度。

layoutNotes.en: More actors and use cases require clear boundaries and readable relationship routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多人物、边界与用例会扩展关联通道，需要避让不同分组和人物名称。

layoutNotes.en: More grammar branches require additional tracks and nested branch spacing.
layoutNotes.zh: 可选项、重复项与候选分支增加后，轨道会同时向横向和纵向展开。

layoutNotes.en: More nested entries require indentation and larger subtree spacing.
layoutNotes.zh: 目录数量与嵌套深度增加后，缩进、分支线与画布高度随之扩展。

layoutNotes.en: More sets and intersections require distinct set labels and intersection labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 从两个集合增加到三个集合后，圆的位置与多重交集区域会发生变化。

layoutNotes.en: More lanes and steps require wider lanes and clear cross lane routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 泳道、步骤和交接增加后，泳道尺寸与跨泳道的连线路径都会变化。

layoutNotes.en: More causes require additional branches and readable nested cause labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 主因和次因增加后，鱼骨数量、分支长度与画布高度会扩展。

layoutNotes.en: More events and commands require additional time frames and connection routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 事件帧和引用增加后，横向时间顺序扩展，并出现更多跨泳道依赖。

sources.en:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User
    participant App as App
    participant API as Server
    User->>App: Submit request
    App->>+API: Validate and process
    Note over App,API: Native messages, activations and branches
    alt Valid request
        API-->>App: Return result
    else Invalid request
        API-->>App: Return error
    end
    deactivate API
    App-->>User: Show response
sources.zh:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as 用户
    participant App as 应用
    participant API as 服务端
    User->>App: 提交请求
    App->>+API: 校验并处理
    Note over App,API: 原生消息、激活与分支
    alt 请求有效
        API-->>App: 返回结果
    else 请求无效
        API-->>App: 返回错误
    end
    deactivate API
    App-->>User: 展示响应

sources.en:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User
    participant API@{ "type": "control", "alias": "Service" }
    User->>+API: Submit task
    create participant Worker as Temporary worker
    API->>Worker: Create and run
    loop Process batches
        Worker->>Worker: Process data
    end
    note over API,Worker
        Release the worker after the task
        The lifeline ends at the destroy message
    end note
    Worker-->>API: Return result
    destroy Worker
    API-xWorker: Release resources
    API-->>-User: Return result
sources.zh:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as 用户
    participant API@{ "type": "control", "alias": "服务" }
    User->>+API: 提交任务
    create participant Worker as 临时工作进程
    API->>Worker: 创建并执行
    loop 处理批次
        Worker->>Worker: 处理数据
    end
    note over API,Worker
        任务结束后释放工作进程
        生命线在销毁消息处结束
    end note
    Worker-->>API: 返回结果
    destroy Worker
    API-xWorker: 释放资源
    API-->>-User: 返回结果

sources.en:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Ready
    state Ready <<fork>>
    Ready --> Loading
    Ready --> Connecting
    Loading --> Joined
    Connecting --> Joined
    state Joined <<join>>
    Joined --> Active
    state "Active" as Active {
        [*] --> Idle
        Idle --> Busy : Receive task
        Busy --> Idle : Done
        --
        [*] --> Offline
        Offline --> Online : Connect
        Online --> Offline : Disconnect
    }
    note right of Active
        Two regions run in parallel
        Each retains its initial state
    end note
    Active --> [*] : Exit

        [*] --> Idle

        Busy --> Idle : 完成
        --

    }

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as User
    participant Web as Client
    participant API as Order service
    participant Stock as Stock service
    participant Pay as Payment service
    participant Notify as Notification service
    User->>Web: Submit order
    Web->>+API: Create order
    API->>Stock: Check and reserve stock
    Stock-->>API: Return reservation
    alt Stock available
        API->>Pay: Create payment
        Pay-->>API: Return payment URL
        API-->>Web: Await payment
        Web-->>User: Show payment page
        User->>Web: Confirm payment
        Web->>Pay: Submit payment
        Pay-->>API: Payment notification
        API->>Stock: Confirm stock deduction
        Stock-->>API: Stock deducted
        API->>Notify: Send order confirmation
        Notify-->>User: Push order status
    else Out of stock
        API->>Notify: Send stock alert
        Notify-->>User: Suggest revising order
    end
    API-->>-Web: Return final status
    Web-->>User: Show order details
sources.zh:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as 用户
    participant Web as 客户端
    participant API as 订单服务

    User->>Web: 提交订单

    API->>Stock: 检查并预留库存
    Stock-->>API: 返回预留结果
    alt 库存充足
        API->>Pay: 创建支付单
        Pay-->>API: 返回支付地址
        API-->>Web: 等待支付
        Web-->>User: 展示支付页面
        User->>Web: 确认支付
        Web->>Pay: 提交支付
        Pay-->>API: 支付完成通知
        API->>Stock: 确认扣减库存
        Stock-->>API: 扣减完成
        API->>Notify: 发送订单确认
        Notify-->>User: 推送订单状态

    API-->>-Web: 返回最终状态
    Web-->>User: 展示订单详情

layoutNotes.en: More nodes require new layers, branch spacing and routes between groups.
layoutNotes.zh: 节点增加后，分支、汇合与跨组连线需要重新分层和避障。

layoutNotes.en: More participants and messages change lifeline spacing, frame height and message wrapping.
layoutNotes.zh: 参与者与消息增加后，生命线间距、片段高度和消息换行随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More classes and relationships require additional layers, member sections and connection ports.
layoutNotes.zh: 类和关系增加后，卡片分层、成员分区与关系端口更加明显。

layoutNotes.en: More states and transitions require room for nested regions and transition labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多状态会增加转移通道，复合状态需要独立布局。

layoutNotes.en: More entities require larger attribute cards and clearer relationship routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 实体数量和字段增加后，实体卡片的尺寸与关系分层随之扩展。

layoutNotes.en: More slices require space for labels and a balanced legend.
layoutNotes.zh: 分类增加后，扇区变细，图例和标签更密集。

layoutNotes.en: More tasks require additional rows, dependency routes and date labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多任务和阶段会扩展时间跨度与任务行，窄画布需要更紧凑的时间轴。

layoutNotes.en: More branches and commits require distinct lanes and spaced commit labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 提交和分支增加后，会出现更多分支轨道、合并线与提交标签。

layoutNotes.en: More branches require balanced subtree spacing around the root.
layoutNotes.zh: 分支和层级增加后，左右子树展开，父节点位置随子树高度调整。

layoutNotes.en: More periods and events require additional sections and readable event labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 阶段和事件增加后，横向时间线变长，窄画布会改为纵向排列。

layoutNotes.en: More steps and actors require additional lanes and wrapped task labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多阶段、步骤和参与者会扩展旅程，窄画布会重排步骤卡片。

layoutNotes.en: More data requires readable axes, series spacing and a balanced legend.
layoutNotes.zh: 数据点和系列增加后，柱宽、折线密度、刻度与图例排列随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: The four quadrant coordinate structure remains fixed as more points are added.
layoutNotes.zh: 固定四象限坐标结构，增加数据点不改变分区方式，保留单例。

layoutNotes.en: More requirements require additional layers and readable relationship labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 需求、实现和验证对象增加后，关系图会出现多层追踪路径。

layoutNotes.en: More elements require space for boundaries, cards and relationships.
layoutNotes.zh: 人物、系统边界和服务增加后，跨边界关系和卡片布局更复杂。

layoutNotes.en: More flows require additional layers and proportional flow spacing.
layoutNotes.zh: 来源、流向与权重增加后，节点分层、条带宽度和流量分配随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More blocks require additional rows, columns and connection routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 块数量增加后会换行，跨列块与多行连接形成更丰富的网格。

layoutNotes.en: More fields require additional bit rows and clearly bounded field labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 字段和位宽增加后，字段跨越更多行，窄字段的标签显示也会变化。

layoutNotes.en: More cards require taller columns and readable card labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 列与卡片增加后，列宽、卡片换行和看板高度需要适应容器。

layoutNotes.en: More groups and services require additional layers and explicit connection ports.
layoutNotes.zh: 服务与分组增加后，跨组连接、分支端口与图形中心对齐更加明显。

layoutNotes.en: More axes and series require readable axis labels and a balanced legend.
layoutNotes.zh: 维度与数据系列增加后，网格角度、曲线密度和图例布局随之变化。

layoutNotes.en: More values require proportional nested rectangles and readable labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多层级与不均匀权重会改变矩形切分，小面积区域会减少标签。

layoutNotes.en: The engine information display has a fixed structure and needs one example.
layoutNotes.zh: 固定的引擎信息展示，无需按数据规模拆分示例。

layoutNotes.en: More agents and branches require additional layers and group routing.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多智能体和任务分支会增加并行路径、汇合点与层级跨度。

layoutNotes.en: More actors and use cases require clear boundaries and readable relationship routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 更多人物、边界与用例会扩展关联通道，需要避让不同分组和人物名称。

layoutNotes.en: More grammar branches require additional tracks and nested branch spacing.
layoutNotes.zh: 可选项、重复项与候选分支增加后，轨道会同时向横向和纵向展开。

layoutNotes.en: More nested entries require indentation and larger subtree spacing.
layoutNotes.zh: 目录数量与嵌套深度增加后，缩进、分支线与画布高度随之扩展。

layoutNotes.en: More sets and intersections require distinct set labels and intersection labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 从两个集合增加到三个集合后，圆的位置与多重交集区域会发生变化。

layoutNotes.en: The five domain framework remains fixed as more entries are added.
layoutNotes.zh: 固定五领域框架，增加条目不改变领域结构，保留单例。

layoutNotes.en: The value chain and evolution coordinate structure remains fixed as more components are added.
layoutNotes.zh: 固定价值链与演化坐标，增加组件不改变坐标结构，保留单例。

layoutNotes.en: More lanes and steps require wider lanes and clear cross lane routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 泳道、步骤和交接增加后，泳道尺寸与跨泳道的连线路径都会变化。

layoutNotes.en: More causes require additional branches and readable nested cause labels.
layoutNotes.zh: 主因和次因增加后，鱼骨数量、分支长度与画布高度会扩展。

layoutNotes.en: More events and commands require additional time frames and connection routes.
layoutNotes.zh: 事件帧和引用增加后，横向时间顺序扩展，并出现更多跨泳道依赖。
